why: The librarian agent was renamed from Lucille to Lucy, so her project settings move to match.
The questions log, risk tracker, and task list move from markdown tables to YAML, like the decision log, so long entries, dated risk updates, and edits from the pages stay readable and safe.

Each risk is now a short one-line summary with the detail in a separate description, so lists and pages stay readable. The summaries are taken from the start of each risk, so reread them and reword any that read badly.
Raw transcripts now have their own folder, docs/transcripts/raw/, next to the cleaned copies, so Drive snapshots are saved there.
Only cleaned transcripts are committed by default now: raw ones, with the small talk and anything sensitive said on the call, stay on this computer in docs/transcripts/raw/.
ask: Keep raw transcripts out of git from now on, and commit only the cleaned copies? (Recommended.)

why: Raw transcripts committed before are moved into docs/transcripts/raw/, so git stops tracking them. Git history keeps them, and they stay on this computer.
ask: Move the raw transcripts already committed into docs/transcripts/raw/ so they stop being tracked? (Recommended; the commit will show them as deleted.)
